scope.deliverable: Polished static raft asset and export evidence

palette_screenshot.inspection: Visually inspected by parent authoring and coordinating agents

art_direction.edge_treatment: Rounded plank edges, smooth rounded floats and bindings
art_direction.silhouette_priority: Broad readable walking deck over two distinct longitudinal floats
art_direction.variation: Restrained differences in plank ends and float tips

material_roles.end_grain: Paler wood with readable end grain

art_direction.surface_detail: Restrained grain and rope fiber detail; material separation must survive preview scale

coordinates.export_axis_and_scale: Author records FBX and GLB conversion and verifies fresh-import bounds

dimensions.float_diameter: Author choice; assembly must support locked deck height
dimensions.deck_and_batten_thickness: Author choice; assembly contacts must be credible

construction.deck_planks: Broad, approximately longitudinal, with a broadly level top
construction.load_path: Deck rests on transverse battens, which contact the log floats

bindings.contact: Rope follows and seats against the timber it binds
bindings.walking_envelope: Keep raised bindings and knots outside the intended inner walking area

geometry_checks: Unexpected non-manifold boundaries and internal faces
Applied transforms and finite vertex coordinates

materials_and_uvs.texture_resolution: Author choice, recorded in artifact manifest
materials_and_uvs.metallic: Nonmetallic wood and rope; use zero metallic
materials_and_uvs.normal_map_if_produced: Tangent-space convention recorded per exported format
uv_requirements: UV map present for render geometry
Deck faces, edges, float sides, end caps and visible rope receive suitable coverage
No unintended collapsed UV faces or stretching
Atlas references resolve after fresh GLB and FBX import
Report intentional shared UVs separately from accidental overlap

collision.naming: UCX_<render_mesh_name>_<index>, tied to the final FBX render mesh name
collision.role: Simple deck and float collision proxies

gameplay_context.capacity_status: Future gameplay logic; not enforced or proven by this asset
gameplay_context.native_capsule_context_status: Context only; active Blueprint and runtime dimensions not measured
gameplay_context.walkability_status: Design envelope only; Unreal validation deferred

deliverables.exact_filenames: Parent authoring task records final names in artifact manifest

required_metrics: Evaluated vertex, face and triangle counts
Material slots and missing texture references
UV maps, coverage and collapsed UV faces
Collision proxy count and bounds, separately
validation.current_status: Required evidence not generated by document task
deferred: Gameplay camera and game lighting review

review_questions: Are deck, batten, float and rope contacts credible?
Are wood deck, log sides, pale end grain and rope visually distinct?
Is the silhouette broad, rounded and readable with controlled timber variation?
